svg.title: V-11. Security zones and trust boundaries (SysML v2 view securityZones)
svg.desc: Security architecture generated from the SysML v2 model: the security zones of WP-S-07 §3.1 coloured by trust level, the model elements in each zone, and the trust boundaries of §3.2 with what crosses them, their threats and the number of cybersecurity requirements that control them.
svg.text: V-11 · Security zones and trust boundaries
Zones Z1 to Z7 and boundaries TB-1 to TB-7 of WP-S-07 §3, with the model elements in each zone
WP-S-07: LionDriver signing keys (offline), release build host, release record
WP-S-07: comma athena/connect, GitHub, LFS store,
WP-S-07: athenad, uploader, updated, sshd, webrtcd, UI, installer
WP-S-07: pandad, card/controlsd, selfdrived, modeld, dmonitoringmodeld, plannerd, params store, msgq
WP-S-07: panda STM32H7: bootstub (flash sector 0), application firmware, option bytes, opendbc safety code (E-03)
WP-S-07: Toyota ECUs, OBD-II port, harness
Safety mode/param 0xdc, alternative experience 0xdf, bus config 0xdb/0xde, relay debug 0xc5, softloader 0xd1, CAN TX frames
Panda boot and reset lines driven by the SoC (details: private record GD-03)
athena RPCs, uploads, SSH, git updates, AGNOS images, LFS objects
RX plausibility inputs, TX actuation, PCS forwarding
Signed images and manifests; release key material never crosses

Zones and boundaries carry every column of WP-S-07 §3.1 and §3.2 (check M10); the chips are the model elements in each zone (@Zone). Every safety-relevant protection sits at Z1 or below it in the trust order.
